events.outcome: Current Vodafone NL prepaid keeps credit and number active with at least one paid call, SMS, mobile-data session or top-up every six months; after six months of inactivity there is a three-month frozen-credit recovery window. Current community evidence shows overseas acquisition/payment variability and successful SMS/OTP reception, while China-specific cellular OTP reliability remains evidence-scoped.

data.acquisitionSummary: Vodafone Netherlands currently sells prepaid SIM and prepaid eSIM. The official product page lists top-up from EUR5; 2026 community reports show purchase/payment can work with international cards but varies by IP/card context.

keep.action: Make at least one paid call, SMS, mobile-data session or top-up every six months. A standard SMS is currently EUR0.15, so two paid SMS actions per year are the lowest directly priced qualifying usage modeled here; top-up is also valid.

data.chinaActivation: Remote purchase/payment from China is not provider-guaranteed. 2026 community reports show successful overseas ordering/payment as well as card/IP failures; treat China-first acquisition as variable.
data.kyc: No identity/KYC requirement was established from the reviewed prepaid pages; account registration may unlock the advertised first-top-up bonus, but this review does not infer a universal KYC exemption.
data.payment: Official online top-up is current. Community reports show international-card purchase/payment can succeed but is not uniformly reproducible.
data.roamingSms: Vodafone publishes prepaid rates for use abroad, and community reports show SMS/OTP reception in overseas setups. Mainland-China cellular incoming-SMS/third-party OTP reliability was not independently provider-reconciled in this bounded review.
data.refund: Current eSIM/SIM replacement recovery abroad was not fully reconciled.
data.tariffSummary: Current standard prepaid: EUR0.20/min, EUR0.15/SMS, EUR0.10/MB; top-up from EUR5. One paid use or top-up every six months preserves validity, followed by a three-month recovery window if missed.
guideSteps: Acquire a current Vodafone NL prepaid SIM/eSIM through the official prepaid path.
Record the first-use date and make one qualifying paid use or top-up before six months elapse.
Treat China-specific OTP delivery and remote payment as evidence-scoped rather than guaranteed.
